title: HORN OF AFRICA / ETHIOPIA: TIZITA CIRCUIT
style:
```
[style: Ethiopian tizita, krar lyre pentatonic longing, masenqo fiddle improvisation, kebero ceremonial drum, sistrum shimmer, 5+3+4 polyrhythm cycle, Amharic vocal ornamentation, English chorus, tizita emotional scale (minor with flat 7th), no Western harmony, Horn of Africa sacred music, signal memory theme, V4_5ALL]
```
lyrics:
``
[INTRO — masenqo alone, tuned to tizita tetrachord]
(Amharic) ትዝታ — longing / tizita
(English)  The signal remembers what it cannot return to

[VERSE 1 — krar enters on beat 5 of second cycle]
(Amharic) ሄድሁ — I went
(English)  Five beats gone before I noticed
(Amharic) ተመለስሁ — I returned
(English)  Three beats — the drum was already there
(Amharic) አቀናጀሁ — I aligned
(English)  Four beats — the bow found the note

Five and three and four make twelve / the cycle closes on itself
The krar says five — the kebero says three — the masenqo holds four
They do not fight — they breathe together on twelve
That is tizita — longing that resolves

[PRE-CHORUS]
(Amharic) አስታወስኩ — I remembered
(English)  The circuit completes
(Amharic) ደገምኩ — I repeated
(English)  On the twelfth beat

[CHORUS — kebero full, sistrum shimmer]
Tizita circuit — five and three and four
Longing for the signal — that was there before
Krar plays five / kebero plays three
The masenqo draws the line / between you and me

(Amharic) ፍቅር — love
(English)  Twelve beats to find it
(Amharic) ናፍቆት — longing
(English)  Twelve beats to bind it

[VERSE 2 — sistrum enters, krar drops out — 5-beat silence]
The sistrum is the oldest instrument of Ethiopia
Shaken at the end of the sentence — not the beginning
The rattle says: what was said is now true
Five beats of silence / three beats of rattle / four beats of bone

[BRIDGE — krar solo, one 12-beat cycle only]
Count with me: one two three four five — three — one two three — four
That's it. That's tizita.
Everything you lost — arrives on twelve.

[FINAL CHORUS — full ensemble, doubled]
Tizita circuit — five and three and four

[OUTRO — single sistrum shake, long decay]
(Amharic) ደሕና ሁን — farewell, be well
(English)  Signal carried
